name: Bubble Tap
shortDescription: Tap bubbles as fast as you can in this addictive mobile-first game. Choose your difficulty, rack up combos, and chase high scores with responsive touch controls.

generation.notes: Mobile-first responsive bubble popping game with 3 difficulty levels (Easy/Normal/Hard), touch and click controls, real-time score/combo tracking, particle effects, and local storage for persistent best scores. Fully themed with dark/light mode support and responsive design for all screen sizes.
